summary: Nordic American Tankers Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, presenting its second-quarter 2026 earnings and dividend announcement for the period ended June 30, 2026. The report highlights a quarterly cash dividend of $0.27 per share, increased from $0.22, payable September 24, 2026, to shareholders of record September 10, 2026. Net result was $68.3 million, up from $46.3 million in the previous quarter. The filing also notes operational updates, including vessel sales and geopolitical impacts. This is a routine earnings and dividend report, not a special situation.
